name: rain_water

source.title: Kevyt sade veden pintaan / Light rain on surface of a lake water
source.author: YleArkisto
source.notes: 48 kHz 24-bit stereo, 213 s of light rain on a lake (the Finnish broadcaster Yle's archive), mixed to mono: drops plinking on the water, bright (most of it 1-6 kHz) with almost nothing under 200 Hz, steady within 3 dB (sound-ambience.py). Chosen by the author over TRP's (572429), Garuda1982's (636272), Mjeno's (399281) and klangfabrik's (157161) rain on water (see SOUND_REWORK.md). Stretches picked for the most drops (8.5-9 a second, 4 dB over their 1 s median, 0.8-6 kHz), none more than 9.2 dB over it, level steady within 0.9 dB between halves (scratchpad pick_swells.py); its plinks stand further out than leaves' drops, so the spike limit is 1 dB looser than theirs.

shape: 2 s swells (0.6 s in, 0.5 s out), as the calm and medium rain's, played with them where a rain sound lands on water (RainSurface.WATER), in place of most of it (the filtered rain keeps 0.3). Cut at the calm rain's average level (RMS about -46 dB); how loud it plays against the rain is set in code.
